description: At the end of setup_seed_data, threads.insert('thread-alpha', alpha_thread_id) overwrites the entry that was inserted earlier when thread-starter was created (via threads.insert). The duplication is silent and a contributor editing the seeding order could accidentally break the mapping. A short comment explaining why the re-insert exists (to ensure the canonical 'thread-alpha' key is set after all replies are imported) would prevent this confusion.
title: seed.rs: overwrite of threads['thread-alpha'] at EOF is silently surprising
